title: Lodevator
body:
### About
A bare-bones PaperMC elevator plugin, ported from [CivMC's SimpleAdminHacks](https://github.com/CivMC/Civ/tree/main/plugins/simpleadminhacks-paper).

### Commands
- `/lodevator` - shows your current elevator trigger method (per-player), clickable to toggle
  - `/lodevator toggle` - manually toggle your trigger method
  - `/lodevator reload` - reload plugin data & configuration, requires the permission `lodevator.reload` (or OP)
